title: docs.rs metadata inconsistent: pkix-chain-simple missing all-features
description:
pkix-chain-simple's Cargo.toml package.metadata.docs.rs section has only rustdoc-args but is missing all-features = true:

  [package.metadata.docs.rs]
  rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

Every other crate in the workspace that has a package.metadata.docs.rs section includes both:

  [package.metadata.docs.rs]
  all-features = true
  rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

pkix-chain-simple has no optional features currently (default = []), so the omission has no practical effect today. But if features are added later, the docs.rs build will not enable them, causing feature-gated items to be missing from the published docs. The inconsistency with every other crate in the workspace creates a maintenance trap.

Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-chain-simple/Cargo.toml line 24
